content.short: Coinshift is a treasury management platform for DAOs and Web3 firms, streamlining multi-sig operations and payroll.
content.description:
Coinshift is a leading treasury management solution built on top of Safe, designed to help DAOs and Web3 companies manage digital assets with ease. It provides a unified dashboard for managing multiple multi-sig wallets across various chains, including Ethereum, Polygon, and Arbitrum. Organizations can execute mass payouts and payroll in a single transaction, significantly reducing administrative overhead and gas costs for large-scale operations.

The platform integrates with protocols like Superfluid to enable real-time salary streaming, allowing contributors to receive payments second-by-second. Coinshift also offers robust financial reporting tools, automated accounting, and role-based access controls, ensuring transparency and security. By simplifying complex financial workflows, Coinshift empowers Web3 teams to focus on growth while maintaining rigorous treasury standards.
